result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its content, IP and data; Client solely owns results, customizations and other materials created specifically for it through a present assignment; TrueLink retains its pre-existing IP and Interface; and Client receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP. Joint ownership is excluded. The addition is targeted and preserves TrueLink’s ownership of its existing platform. Drafting is professional, though the margin comment inaccurately calls the embedded-IP licence a 'licence back,' and the continuing broad licence permitting TrueLink to resell and exploit Credit Data may warrant separate commercial review even though it does not negate Client’s ownership.
